enabled.description: Enables the CNPG cluster. Supports Helm `tpl`.

primary.description: Marks this CNPG cluster as the primary one.

hibernate.description: Puts the CNPG cluster in hibernation mode. Poolers and scheduled backups are stopped too.

labels.description: Additional labels for all CNPG objects.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for all CNPG objects.

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the `labels` of all CNPG objects.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the `annotations` of all CNPG objects.

namespace.description: Namespace of the CNPG objects. Supports Helm `tpl`, and overrides `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

type.description: Type of the CNPG database, which selects the image: `postgres` for plain PostgreSQL, `postgis` with PostGIS, `timescaledb` with TimescaleDB, `vectors` with pgvecto.rs or `vectorchord` with VectorChord.

pgVersion.description: Major version of PostgreSQL to use. It selects the image (`postgres<type><version>Image`, eg `postgres16Image`) and changes the cluster naming scheme. Without a value, `global.fallbackDefaults.cnpg.pgVersion` is used.

mode.description: Cluster mode of operation. `standalone` creates a new or updates an existing CNPG cluster, `recovery` creates a cluster from a backup, object store or `pg_basebackup`. `replica` is accepted but not implemented yet.

upgradeMajor.description: Reserved for major version upgrades. Accepted, but not acted on yet.

database.description: Name of the database, owned by `user`.

user.description: Name of the database user that owns the database.

password.description: Password of the database user, written to a Secret. Change it from the default.

enablePodMonitor.description: Create a PodMonitor for the cluster.

disableDefaultQueries.description: Do not run the default queries of the metrics exporter.

key.description: Key of the ConfigMap or Secret with the queries.

usage.description: Usage of the column, eg `LABEL`, `GAUGE` or `COUNTER`.

additionalProperties.description: How the column with this name is exported as a metric.

items.description: Describes the columns the query returns, keyed by column name.

metrics.description: Metrics the query returns, by column.

expandObjectName.description: Expand the name of the ConfigMap or Secret with the name of the release.

items.description: A custom query of the metrics exporter, read from a ConfigMap or Secret with `name` and `key`.

customQueries.description: Additional queries for the metrics exporter.

method.description: Recovery method. `backup` recovers from a CNPG backup of the same cluster in the same namespace (needs `backupName`), `object_store` from a barman object store (needs `credentials`), `pg_basebackup` is accepted but not implemented yet.

serverName.description: Overrides the `serverName` of the recovery object store.

time.description: Point in time recovery target time, in RFC3339 format.

destinationPath.description: Overrides the provider specific default path of the object store to recover from. Defaults to `s3://<bucket>/<path>/<release name>/cnpg`.

credentials.description: Name of the credentials in `.Values.credentials` for the object store to recover from.

revision.description: Revision appended to the `serverName` of the recovery archive, so restore and backup use different archives. Must be a string.

backupName.description: Name of the CNPG backup to recover from. Required when `method` is `backup`.

clusterName.description: Not read by common, the name of the cluster is generated.

enabled.description: Enables the backups of the CNPG cluster. Backups are not configured by default.
Encrypts the backups with AES256 when enabled.

serverName.description: Overrides the `serverName` in the object store of the backups.

destinationPath.description: Overrides the provider specific default path of the object store for the backups. Defaults to `s3://<bucket>/<path>/<release name>/cnpg`.

target.description: Instance the backups are taken from, `primary` or `prefer-standby`. Empty uses the default of CloudNativePG.

credentials.description: Name of the credentials in `credentials` for the object store of the backups. Required when backups are enabled.

name.description: Name of the scheduled backup. Required.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the backup, with seconds, eg `0 0 0 * * *`. Required.

backupOwnerReference.description: Owner of the created backups: `none`, `self` or `cluster`. Defaults to `none`.

immediate.description: Also take a backup right away.

labels.description: Additional labels for this scheduled backup, merged with `backups.labels`.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for this scheduled backup, merged with `backups.annotations`.

items.description: A recurring backup of the cluster, created as a CNPG `ScheduledBackup`.

scheduledBackups.description: Backups that are taken on a schedule.

retentionPolicy.description: Retention policy of the backups: a number followed by `d` (days), `w` (weeks) or `m` (months), eg `30d`.

labels.description: Additional labels for the backup objects of the CNPG cluster, merged with the root `labels`.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the backup objects of the CNPG cluster, merged with the root `annotations`.

enabled.description: Set to `false` to disable the `bzip2` compression of the backups.

revision.description: Revision appended to the `serverName` of the backup archive, so restore and backup use different archives. Must be a string. Can not match the revision of `recovery` in recovery mode.

jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs used to upload the backups. Uses `2` when unset.

labels.description: Additional labels for this manual backup, merged with `backups.labels`.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for this manual backup, merged with `backups.annotations`.

items.description: A backup of the cluster that is taken once, created as a CNPG `Backup`.

manualBackups.description: Backups that are taken once, when they are added.

backups.description: Backups of the cluster to a barman object store.

createRO.description: Also create a pooler for the read-only instances.

instances.description: Number of pooler instances. Gets scaled to 0 if hibernation is true.

parameters.description: PgBouncer settings, keyed by name. Values support Helm `tpl`.

pooler.description: PgBouncer pooler in front of the cluster.

std.description: Connection URL of the read-write endpoint.

nossl.description: Connection URL of the read-write endpoint with `sslmode=disable`.

porthost.description: Host and port of the read-write endpoint.

jdbc.description: JDBC URL of the read-write endpoint.

stdRO.description: Connection URL of the read-only pooler.

nosslRO.description: Connection URL of the read-only pooler with `sslmode=disable`.

porthostRO.description: Host and port of the read-only pooler.

jdbcRO.description: JDBC URL of the read-only pooler.

creds.description: Credentials and URLs of the cluster, written by common so apps can use them. Read only.

additionalProperties.description: A CloudNativePG cluster, keyed by name.

description: CloudNativePG clusters, keyed by name (`main` by default).
